correctness.rationale: The 0,-u,-uz spectral decomposition of the reversible star generator gives every endpoint entry as a combination of r(w),r(zw) with w=uh and z=1+mv/u. From gamma=1-1/sqrt2, exact scalar r(x) has unique global minimum -eta at w*=4+3sqrt2; F(x)=(1-r(x))/x is positive and strictly decreasing, forcing all distinct-state offdiagonal entries strictly positive. For u=v and m<=4, the lower diagonal bound (1-m*eta)/(m+1)>0. For m>=5 and z>3+2sqrt2 a hub diagonal at zw=w* is negative; for z below or equal, every leaf diagonal at w=w* is <= (297-211sqrt2)/(98m)<0. The latter radical is exact negative. Decay to rank-one strictly positive stationary projector proves return of positivity for large h. Independent SymPy exact identities and 50 ratio/dimension witness cases reproduced the signs; the unbounded quantifier relies on the inequalities.
